Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS following additional Terms & Conditions on the subject bid for procurement of Hot Mix Plant 40/60 TPH with matching Gen Set is mentioned: PQ CRITERIA/OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS. 01. (a) Performance Evaluation of Offered Plant. If the offered plant is not trial evaluated in BRO . The bidder must be an OEM and must have sold i n market a minimum 03 Nos of plant of similar or higher capacity in last three years, ending on 3 1st March of the previous financial year . Copies of related Supply Orders and Performance certifica tes, in support of these will be submitted by the bidder. BRO reserves the right to conduct limited ‘

No Cost No Commitment’ basis performance trials for a period of 50 hours operation at a mutually agreed project location including Vendor Premises. OR If the offered plant is trial evaluated in BRO and is not in service in BRO / Indian Army. The offered equipment has been trial evaluated and found successful in BRO/ h as been found qualified in staff evaluation for procurement by Indian Army. Documentary proof in support of this be enclosed. OR If the offered plant is in service in BRO. The offered plant is presently in service with BRO and its Pe rformance is Satisfactory. Performance of plant already inducted in BRO shall be evaluated internal ly by E4 (Repair)/ TA Dte/HQ DGBR. In case found unsatisfactory, the bid of concerned bidder shall be rejected. In this regard the decision of BRO is final. (b) Experience Criteria : The Bidder i.e. OEM (themselves or through resellers(s)) should hav e regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products for 3 years before the b id opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having s upplied a definite quantity during each of the year. 02. Commissioning of equipment (By Seller). The equipment shall be commissioned by the Seller within a maximum period of 30 days from the date of receipt of communication from the consignee confirming that the plant is ready for commis sioning. For any delay in commissioning of such plant beyond 30 days of receipt of communication, a penalty @ 0.10% of the contract price per day per plant, subject to a maximum of 10% of the value of non-commissioned plants, shall be levied on the Seller. This amount shall be recovered either from any payment due to the SELLER or from the Performance Bank Guarantee, whichever is applicable. 03. Warranty (i) The SELLER warrants that the goods supplied under this contract conform to technical specificat ions prescribed and shall perform according to the said Technical Specifications. (ii) The SELLER warrants for a period of 12 months or 1000 operational hours from the date of c ommissioning, whichever is earlier, that the goods/stores supplied under this contract and each co mponent used in the manufacture thereof shall be free from all types of defects/failures. (iii) Idling charges will be applicable for the period of defects. 04. Resources for providing spares & consumables for maintenance up to 10 years: The bidde r should have adequate facilities pan India to carry out after sales service at various consignees for a total period of 10 (Ten) years including Guarantee/Warranty period of 01(One) year and 09 (Nine) years thereaft er in terms of supply of spares. 05. Idling Charges. In case of defects developing during the warranty period, if the plant is not put back in running con dition (by Seller) within a period of maximum of 21 days from the date of issue of notification, failing which the seller shall be liable to be charged a n idling cost for the entire delay duration (Incl 21 days) @ INR Rs. 9985.00 (Rupees Nine Thousand Nine Hundred Eighty Five Only) per day subject to a maximum of 5% of the Contract Value, s hall be levied on the Seller. This amount shall be recovered either from any payment du

e to the SELLER or from the Performance Bank Guarantee, whichever is applicable. 06. Price to be quoted shall inclusive of GST & freight charges. 07. Training : Successful bidder shall provide training at consignee location for operators and field work shop personnel’s. The training will be conducted for a minimum of Twenty one days. The training will be conducted in two Phases. Phase one training of seven days duration within ninety days post delivery a nd Phase two training of Fourteen days duration 90 days prior to termination of warranty. 08. This Bid is reserved for Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) only. 09. Engineering Support Package. (i) Tools. One set of tools required for undertaking regular and periodical maintenance, shall b e provided along with the each plant, on FREE OF COST. (ii) MRLS. Three Set of hard copy of document containing Manufacturer Recommended List of S pares (MRLS) covering both repair & maintenance spares for 1000Hrs/2000 Hrs/5000 Hrs and list o f one set document containing list of overhaul spares for 100 plant shall be provided at the time of PDI. (iii) Technical Literature: All Technical Literatures (hard copy in English) described below shall b e supplied by the Seller on FREE OF COST along with each plant:- (aa) Operation, Repair and maintenance manual for both engine and plant. (ab) Workshop manual for both engine and plant. (ac) Illustrated parts catalogue for both engine and plant. (ad) Illustrated list of Special Maintenance Tools, if any. (ae) Lubrication charts for complete plant. (af) In addition, following literature to be handed over to HQ DGBR/ E4 Tech :- (i) Illustrated parts catalogue of engine and plant – 05 Sets. (ii) Running, Repair and Maint manual for both engine and plant – 03 Sets. (iii) Lubrication charts for complete plant – 03 Sets. (iv) Workshop manual for both engine and plant – 02 Sets. (v) Soft copy of all above literature at S/No. (i) to (iv) – 01 Set. 10. The bidder shall submit a certificate on compliance of Rule 144 (xi) of GFR 2017 as per Ministry of Fi nance, Department of Expenditure , Public Procurement Division vide their order Nos dated 23 Jul 2020 an d its subsequent Procurement Orders 2 and 3 dated 23 and 24 Jul 2020 vide their File No 06 / 18 / 2019. M odel Certificate enclosed as Appendix ‘A’.
